remarks: Charming Victorian Townhouse in the Heart of SONO  Discover this delightful Victorian townhouse in the vibrant heart of SONO, where chic dining, shopping, and entertainment are just steps away. The main level boasts a bright and spacious living room with a cozy fireplace and a unique octagon-shaped seating area. Enjoy meals in the elegant dining room with custom cabinetry, or relax in the beautiful eat-in kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, a second fireplace, and gleaming hardwood floors. Another large living room on this level has two additional closets, providing ample storage space.  The lower level includes two generously sized bedrooms, a full bath, and large closets, along with a convenient laundry room equipped with a full-sized washer and dryer. With 2000 square feet of living space and two off-street parking spaces, this home is a rare find brimming with character and charm.  Just two blocks from the Train Station/Metro North, half a block to Washington Street, and a short walk to Vet's Park, this prime location puts you within easy reach of shops, restaurants, a movie theater, and more. The property features immaculate grounds.   Don't miss the opportunity to make this charming townhouse your new home!
